detail: Mechanism: the test sets FN_NATIVE_EXTENT_CACHE_TEST_OFF=1; fnn-extent-cache-limit is then 0 (host/native/extent.lisp:256), ACL2's fn-pxe-cache-mode answers :read-resources-unavailable (books/page-read-executor.lisp:16: cache off never authorizes unfunded synchronous I/O), fnn-extent-entry-direct refuses the checkpoint walk's read (extent.lisp:1433), and fn-orln-read-refusal-outcome defers the publication (books/owner-resource-line.lisp). Case (b): the product refuses this configuration by an ACL2 decision, now a keystone (fn-orln-cache-off-walk-defers-the-publication, teeth in tests/acl2/owner-resource-line-tests.lisp); the test drops the cache-off env. The (1, b'') health-count half (18 not <= 17) is not addressed here. history-root-reserve-exhausted at open is a separate item (N's probe). The pool-exhausted-with-cache-on case is already relieved by fnn-extent-cache-yield-oldest (extent.lisp:1427). Natives: see state.
notes: 10-09 builder-B: the health-count half: the transit bound counts the commit wake (fnn-feed-idle-wait :commit) and the window is timed from before the first sample. tests.test_native_owner_scheduler OK 10/10 on images at f8a78b7b8 (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/b-control/native-f8a78b7b8714).
title: tests.test_native_owner_scheduler A6 campaign: the snapshot did not publish (cache-off configuration; the test was wrong)
